provenance.en: Aggregate measurements retained from the original local runs. Raw logs and per-input reports are not distributed in Git. Reproduction commands generate new local evidence under build/.
provenance.zh: 从原始本地测量提取的聚合结果。Git 不分发原始日志和逐输入报告；复现命令在 build/ 下生成新的本地证据。
